commitments.title: 1. Compromisos del Creador
commitments.p0: Al activar el modo creador, formas un acuerdo vinculante con Artypot LLC, una sociedad de responsabilidad limitada de Florida, y aceptas lo siguiente.
commitments.p1Lead: 1.1 Entregar lo que pide la recompensa.
commitments.p1Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] You commit to performing or producing what a bounty describes — whether that is creating a work, releasing a product (free or paid), making a public statement or disclosure, achieving or publishing a result, or any other public act — in good faith and submitting it for review. Funds are only collected from fans after you submit your completed fulfilment and the Artypot Council confirms it satisfies the bounty — payment never precedes delivery. Submitting something you did not actually do or produce, claiming a result you did not achieve, submitting work you do not own the rights to, or otherwise not fulfilling the bounty may result in suspension or termination of your creator account.
commitments.p2Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] The social handles and websites you verify through Artypot must genuinely represent your identity as a creator. You must not impersonate another person or entity or misrepresent your affiliation with any platform account.
commitments.p3Lead: 1.3 Proporcionar información fiscal precisa cuando se solicite.
commitments.p3Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] When your cumulative annual payouts reach IRS reporting thresholds (or equivalent thresholds under applicable local law), you agree to provide a completed W-9 (for U.S. persons) or W-8BEN (for non-U.S. persons) upon request. Failure to provide required tax documentation will result in a hard block on payouts until documentation is provided.
commitments.p4Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] You must maintain an accurate country of tax residence (and U.S. state or territory, if applicable) in your creator profile. This information is used solely for earnings reporting and tax compliance purposes.
commitments.p5Lead: 1.5 Cumplir con todas las leyes aplicables.
commitments.p5Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] You are solely responsible for complying with all laws applicable to your activities on Artypot, including tax obligations, export controls, and local content regulations.
commitments.p6Lead: 1.6 Las recompensas financian trabajo público, no beneficios privados.
commitments.p6Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] A backing is a contribution toward a public deliverable — it is not a purchase, and it does not entitle the backer to anything the general public does not also receive. You must not offer, promise, or provide any private, personal, or backer-exclusive benefit in exchange for a backing or in recognition of its size, including (without limitation) private access, one-on-one time, physical goods, personalized or backer-owned work, travel, in-person meetings, early or exclusive access, or any preferential treatment. What you deliver or do for a bounty must be a single public result, available to backers and non-backers alike on equal terms — a paid or paywalled result (such as releasing an album for sale) is allowed, so long as backers receive no special access, discount, or priority. The only recognition you may give a backer is a simple public acknowledgment of that individual by name, and only as a discretionary courtesy: a backer is never owed it, acquires no right to it, and has no claim if you choose not to give it. You may not scale recognition by backing size — no tiers, no leaderboard-style prominence, and nothing in which a larger backing buys greater visibility, such as naming the top backer in a video's title. Acknowledgment is for natural persons only: never a business name, mark, logo, URL, or promotional message. Auctioning or selling personal access or private benefits — for example, offering an experience to the highest backer — is prohibited, and converts a non-sale contribution into a transaction our platform and payment partners do not support.
commitments.p7Lead: 1.7 Sin pagos por actos oficiales o campañas.
commitments.p7Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] If you hold public office or are employed by a government, you may not accept or fulfil a bounty that rewards, induces, or is conditioned on anything you do in that official capacity. You also may not use Artypot to raise money for a political campaign, candidate, party, or committee, or for any other election-related purpose. This applies regardless of intent. Bounties for your ordinary work or public acts are unaffected — this is about official acts and campaigns, not about who you are.
commitments.p8Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Creator accounts are currently available only to individuals acting on their own behalf. Artypot does not yet support participation by corporations, LLCs, partnerships, or other business entities, and you may not enable or operate creator mode for or on behalf of any such entity. By enabling creator mode, you represent that you are a natural person, that you are acting solely on your own behalf and not for any business entity, and that your payouts will be reported under your personal taxpayer identity (such as a W-9 or W-8BEN, not an entity tax form). We expect to support business entities in the future; until we announce that support, entity-based participation is not permitted, and an account found to be operated by or for a business entity may have its payouts held or its creator status suspended until the matter is resolved.

role.title: 2. El Papel de Artypot
role.p1Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Artypot is a platform that facilitates fan-funded bounties. Artypot is not your employer, client, agent, or partner. You are an independent creator. Nothing in these terms creates an employment, agency, joint venture, or partnership relationship between you and Artypot.
role.p2Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Artypot acts as a payment intermediary between fans and creators. Artypot collects fan backings, holds them in accordance with its billing and refund policies, and disburses net proceeds to creators after any applicable platform fees and processing costs.
role.p3Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Artypot does not guarantee that any bounty will reach any amount, that fans will fulfill their backings, or that any particular level of earnings will result from your participation.
role.p4Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Bounty completion submissions are reviewed by the Artypot Council, an independent body of verified users. Council decisions regarding approval or rejection of completions are final. There is no formal appeals process, though you may contact us to raise concerns about a decision.

payouts.title: 3. Pagos y Comisiones
payouts.p1Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] To receive a payout you must: (a) have a verified country of tax residence on file; (b) have a connected payout account (via Stripe Connect where available, or another approved payout method); and (c) have provided required tax documentation (a W-9 for U.S. persons, or a W-8BEN for non-U.S. persons) as applicable.
payouts.p2Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Payouts are subject to a minimum balance threshold that depends on your country and payout method, as published on the Artypot website and shown in your creator dashboard from time to time. Balances below the applicable threshold will accumulate until the threshold is met.
payouts.p3Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Artypot deducts a platform fee from each payout, as specified in your creator dashboard and on the Artypot pricing page. Fees are subject to change with 30 days' notice to active creators.
payouts.p4Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Funds collected from fans are subject to a hold period (currently 7 days) before becoming available for withdrawal. This period exists to allow for fraud review and fan dispute resolution.
payouts.p5Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] All transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated. You are responsible for any currency conversion costs incurred by you or your bank.

refunds.title: 4. Reembolsos y Revocaciones
refunds.p1Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Fans may revoke open backings at any time before a bounty is marked complete. Revoked backings are returned to the fan in full; you are not entitled to compensation for revoked backings.
refunds.p2Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] If the Council rejects a completion submission, no funds are collected from fans. You may resubmit after addressing the Council's feedback.
refunds.p3Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] If a fan's bank reverses a charge (a chargeback), the disputed amount — net of the platform fee that was withheld from it — is deducted from your creator balance. This deduction applies whether or not the funds are still within the clearing hold period, and applies even if the funds have already cleared or been paid out to you. Where a single charge covers backings for more than one creator, a chargeback is allocated proportionally across the affected creators, and a chargeback for only part of a charge is clawed back proportionally. Because a chargeback can arrive after you have withdrawn the funds, this deduction may reduce your balance below zero (see 4.6). If a chargeback is later resolved in Artypot's favour, the deducted amount is restored to your balance.
refunds.p4Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Artypot may refund a fan, in whole or in part, at its discretion — for example to resolve a complaint, correct an error, address non-delivery or deficient work, or satisfy a legal or payment-partner requirement. When Artypot issues such a refund, the net amount you received for the affected backing is deducted from your balance and Artypot returns its own platform fee. As with a chargeback, this deduction may reduce your balance below zero. Artypot also reserves the right to claw back disbursed funds in cases of verified fraud or material misrepresentation.
refunds.p5a: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] You may refund every backer of one of your own completed or paid-out bounties from your creator dashboard. Backings that have not yet been billed are cancelled at no cost to you. For backings that have already been charged, each fan is refunded the full amount they paid, and that full amount — including the platform fee — is deducted from your balance; because the refund is voluntary, Artypot does not return its fee on a creator-initiated refund. You may only start a bounty-wide refund when your available balance covers the full amount to be refunded. If it does not, contact
refunds.p5b: and we will help arrange it.
refunds.p6Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] A chargeback (4.3), an Artypot-initiated refund (4.4), or a clawback for fraud or material misrepresentation may reduce your creator balance below zero. A negative balance is carried forward and offset against your future earnings before any further payout is made. If you disable creator mode, close your account, or stop earning while carrying a negative balance, you remain responsible for the outstanding amount, and Artypot may recover it by any lawful means.
refunds.p7Lead: 4.7 Los cargos completados son definitivos para el seguidor.
refunds.p7Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Once the Council confirms a completion and fans are charged, those charges are final and are not refundable at a fan's unilateral request. Refunds occur only in the cases described above: a chargeback (4.3), a refund Artypot elects to issue (4.4), a refund you choose to issue (4.5), or a clawback for verified fraud or material misrepresentation.
refunds.p8Lead: 4.8 Asunción del riesgo de revocación; renuncia a reclamaciones por confianza.
refunds.p8Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Backings on open bounties are expressions of intent, not guaranteed payments, and any backer may revoke, reduce, or withdraw a backing at any time before a bounty is confirmed complete (see 4.1 and 2.3). If you begin, perform, or complete work in anticipation of a bounty, you do so at your own risk and in reliance solely on your own judgment — not on any backing, projected total, or any representation by a backer or by Artypot. You expressly assume the risk that backings may be revoked, reduced, or never charged, and that a bounty may close or expire without any payment. To the fullest extent permitted by law, you waive and release any claim against any backer and against Artypot — including any claim for detrimental reliance, promissory estoppel, breach of an implied promise, lost profits, or the value of work performed — arising out of or relating to the revocation, reduction, or non-fulfilment of any backing before a bounty is confirmed complete.

content.title: 5. Reglas de Contenido
content.p1Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] You must not submit, represent, or claim as your own any work that infringes the copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, or other intellectual property rights of any third party.
content.p2Lead: 5.2 La superficie de Artypot es para todos los públicos.
content.p2Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] Everything you publish or submit to Artypot itself — bounty descriptions and titles, your profile, display name, verified handles, comments, and the notes or links you attach to a completion — must be suitable for a general audience. This material is hosted and publicly displayed by Artypot, so it may not contain sexually explicit material, pornography, nudity, or gratuitous shock content. This is a rule about the on-platform surface; it is not a judgment about the legitimate work you produce, release, or carry out elsewhere.
content.p3Lead: 5.3 Sin comercio de contenido para adultos.
content.p3Rest: [ES pendiente de revisión legal profesional — texto en inglés] You may not use Artypot to solicit, coordinate, or collect payment for sexually explicit or pornographic work, whether or not the work itself is delivered off-platform. retention.p2: Financial records (payment amounts, payout records, receipts) are retained for 7 years as required by US tax law, even after account deletion. These records are anonymised where possible. [ES: pending professional review]

acceptance.p2: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or back a bounty. By using the Platform, you represent that you meet this requirement.

description.title: 2. Qué es Artypot
description.p1: Artypot is a bounty-style crowdfunding platform. Fans ("backers") pool funding toward specific public acts or tasks from public entities ("creators"). Backing is a commitment of funds, but no money moves when you back a bounty. Charges only occur after The Council reviews and confirms a bounty as complete.
description.p2: Artypot is not a tip jar, subscription service, or pre-order platform. It is a mechanism for coordinating demand signals and releasing payment only on delivery.

accounts.title: 3. Cuentas
accounts.p1: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and all activity that occurs under it. Do not share your login credentials.
accounts.p2: You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information when registering. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts with inaccurate or misleading information.
accounts.p3: One person, one account. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent restrictions is prohibited.

bounties.title: 4. Recompensas
bounties.p1: Any registered user may open a bounty for any specific, verifiable public act a named creator could perform, subject to the Content Policy (Section 9). This is deliberately broad. A bounty can ask a creator to create or release a work — free or paid, such as dropping a new album, even behind a paywall — to make a public statement or disclosure, to achieve or publish a result such as a scientific finding, or to do any other defined thing in public. For example, a bounty asking a pseudonymous figure to publicly reveal their identity is a perfectly valid request. If it can be done, verifiably confirmed, and doesn't violate the Content Policy or the other limits in this Section, it can be a bounty.
bounties.p2: Opening a bounty does not guarantee the named creator will fulfil it. The creator is under no contractual obligation to Artypot or to backers. A bounty is an expression of collective demand, not a contract with the creator.
bounties.p3Lead: A bounty funds public work, not private perks.
bounties.p3Rest: Backing is a contribution toward a result that is released or made available publicly and equally to backers and non-backers alike (a paid or paywalled result is allowed, so long as backers receive no special access, discount, or priority). It is not a purchase of goods or services for the backer, and it confers no private benefit, ownership, exclusive access, or preferential treatment. Creators may not offer, and backers may not solicit or demand, any personal or backer-exclusive reward in exchange for a backing or its size — for example, private meetings, physical goods, personalized work, or an experience auctioned to the highest backer. The one form of recognition that remains permitted is a simple public acknowledgment of an individual backer by name, and only as a discretionary courtesy: a backer is never owed it, acquires no right to it, and has no claim if it is omitted, with the creator free to give or withhold it at their sole option.
bounties.p4Lead: No bounties for official acts or political campaigns.
bounties.p4Rest: A bounty may not reward, induce, or be conditioned on an official act — anything a government office holder or employee does, or could do, in their official capacity. Nor may a bounty serve as a contribution to or expenditure for a candidate, campaign, party, or committee, or otherwise aim to influence an election. Funding pointed at an official act or an election can create legal exposure for backers and for Artypot regardless of intent, so we don't allow it. This turns on the purpose of a bounty, not the identity of its subject: a public servant who is also a creator can still be the subject of a bounty for their ordinary work or public acts. We may remove bounties that cross this line and take action on the accounts behind them.
bounties.p5: We reserve the right to remove any bounty at our sole discretion, including but not limited to bounties that are too vague, too difficult to verify completion, harmful, or illegal. We are not obligated to explain every removal, though we will attempt to provide a reason when possible.
bounties.p6: While we are committed to being reasonable, the creator a bounty is directed at may also remove that bounty at their sole discretion, for any reason or no reason.

backing.title: 5. Respaldo y pagos
backing.p1Rest: When you back a bounty, no money moves and no authorization hold is placed on your card. Your card is only charged after The Council confirms a bounty is complete. Confirmed charges are collected together in a monthly billing run (on the 24th of each month), not instantly at the moment of approval.
backing.p2Rest: You may back out at any time before a bounty is confirmed completed by Council, even during the "pending review" stage.
backing.p3Rest: If your card cannot be charged when payment is due (expired card, insufficient funds, etc.), the charge fails and you will be notified. You then have a short grace period to update your payment method. While a failed payment is unresolved you cannot back new bounties, and if it remains unresolved your affected backings will be cancelled.
backing.p4a: You may cancel (revoke) any backing, free of charge and without giving a reason, at any time before The Council confirms the bounty complete — including while it is pending review. Once a bounty is confirmed complete, your backing is
backing.p4b: : it can no longer be cancelled, and it will be charged in the next monthly billing run. Charged payments are

backing.p4d: — but a post-charge refund is an exception we may grant, never an entitlement. This policy is also disclosed where you place a backing, in your backing confirmation email, in the pre-billing preview email, and on every receipt.
backing.p5Rest: If a bounty is closed or revoked before completion, no charges are made. Nothing was ever held against your card.
backing.p6Lead: Derecho de desistimiento (UE, Reino Unido y jurisdicciones de consumo similares):
backing.p6a: If you are a consumer in a jurisdiction that grants a statutory right of withdrawal from distance contracts (such as the EU under Directive 2011/83/EU or the UK under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013), you are hereby informed that, to the extent a backing or any resulting charge is treated as such a contract, you have the right to withdraw from it within 14 days of placing the backing, without giving any reason and at no cost. To exercise this right, cancel the backing from your
backing.p6b: , or notify us by an unequivocal statement to
backing.p6c: . Because no money moves until a bounty completes, withdrawal before completion simply means you are never charged. Note that Artypot's standard back-out right is broader than the statutory minimum: you may cancel any backing, free of charge, at any time before The Council confirms the bounty complete — even after 14 days.
backing.p6Bold: By placing a backing, you expressly request that performance begin before any withdrawal period expires, and you acknowledge that once the contract has been fully performed — that is, once The Council confirms the bounty complete and your card is charged — you lose your right of withdrawal.
backing.p6d: This disclosure is repeated in the confirmation email you receive when you place a backing and on each payment receipt.

backing.p8: If a fan disputes a charge for your work, the disputed amount may be deducted from your earnings.

creators.title: 6. Obligaciones del creador
creators.p1: Creators who claim their profile and accept a bounty agree to deliver or perform the specific work or act described in the bounty in good faith, as understood by their community.
creators.p2: Submission of a completion claim constitutes a representation that the submitted work satisfies the bounty description. Fraudulent submissions — submitting work that does not fulfil the bounty, or submitting work you do not own the rights to — may result in account termination and, where applicable, legal action.
creators.p3: Creators receiving payouts must provide accurate payment and tax information. US-based creators complete a W-9; creators outside the US complete a W-8BEN. Creator payouts currently require a US bank account and are available in the US only for now, with more countries planned. Artypot issues 1099 or 1042-S forms where required by law.

council.title: 7. El Consejo
council.p1: The Council is a group of human reviewers appointed by Artypot. Their role is to verify that a submitted work actually fulfils the bounty before any funds are collected.
council.p2: The Council's decisions are final. There is no formal appeals process, though you may contact us to raise concerns.
council.p3: Council members are not liable for reasonable errors in judgment made in good faith during the review process.

fees.title: 8. Comisiones
fees.p1a: When a bounty pays out, Artypot deducts a
fees.p1b: from the creator's payout. This single fee is all-inclusive: it covers Artypot's operating costs and all payment processing costs (including Stripe card transaction fees). Creators always receive 80% of the total amount backed.
fees.p2: Backers are charged their exact committed amount — no processing surcharges are ever added to a backer's charge.
fees.p3: Fee rates may change with notice. Changes apply to bounties opened after the effective date of the change.

content.title: 9. Política de contenido
content.p1Lead: La superficie de Artypot es apta para todas las edades.
content.p1Rest: Anything you publish or post to the Platform itself — bounty titles and descriptions, profile text, display names, verified handles, comments, and the notes or links you attach to a completion — is hosted and publicly displayed by us and must be suitable for a general audience. It may not contain sexually explicit material, nudity, pornography, or gratuitous shock content. This is a rule about what appears on Artypot; it is not a judgment about the lawful work or public acts a creator produces, releases, or carries out elsewhere.
content.p2Lead: Sin comercio de contenido para adultos.
content.p2Rest: You may not use a bounty to request, commission, coordinate, or fund sexually explicit or pornographic work, whether or not the finished work is delivered off-platform. Artypot is the merchant of record for every charge, and our payment partners (including the card networks and Stripe) prohibit processing payments for adult content. A bounty whose purpose is to fund adult content is therefore not permitted, regardless of where the work is hosted.
content.p3Rest: The following are never permitted on the Platform or in any work funded through it, and apply regardless of where the work is hosted:
content.item1: Content that is illegal under US federal or state law
content.item2: Bounties that pay for an official government act or function as a political campaign contribution (see Section 4)
content.item3: Harassment, credible threats, or targeted hate speech
content.item4: Malware, malicious code, or attempts to compromise the Platform or its users
content.p4: We reserve the right to remove any content and suspend or terminate any account that violates this policy, at our sole discretion and without prior notice.

ip.title: 10. Propiedad intelectual
ip.p1: To the extent fulfilling a bounty produces a copyrightable work or other ownable content, Artypot claims no ownership of it and the creator retains all rights to it. Many bounties — such as making a public statement, revealing information, or releasing or performing something — produce no new ownable work, in which case this Section simply has nothing to operate on.
ip.p2: Backers who fund a bounty receive no special rights, ownership, access, or pricing in anything the bounty produces or causes — they receive the same access as the general public, on the same terms (including where the result is a paid product). Artypot is not a commissioned-work platform, and a backing does not commission work made for the backer.
ip.p3: By posting content to Artypot (e.g., bounty descriptions, profile text), you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display that content on the Platform.

termination.title: 11. Terminación
termination.p1: You may delete your account at any time from your settings page. Deletion cancels all active commitments (no charges) and removes your public profile.
termination.p2: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms, engage in fraud, or abuse the Platform. In cases of serious violations, we reserve the right to take action without notice.

disclaimer.title: 12. Descargos de responsabilidad
disclaimer.p1: Artypot is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the Platform will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that any bounty will be fulfilled.
disclaimer.p2: We are not responsible for the actions of creators, backers, or third parties.

liability.title: 13. Limitación de responsabilidad
liability.p1: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Artypot and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Platform.
liability.p2: Our total liability to you for any claim arising from these Terms or your use of Artypot shall not exceed the total amount you have paid to Artypot in the 12 months preceding the claim.

governing.title: 14. Ley aplicable

governing.p2: Any disputes arising from these Terms shall be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Florida. You consent to personal jurisdiction in those courts.

keep.body: Artypot descuenta una comisión de plataforma del {feePct}% que cubre el procesamiento de tarjetas, la protección antifraude, el alojamiento, el soporte y verduras ecológicas para los miembros del consejo que lo moderan todo. Sin cuota de registro, sin cuota mensual.

paidAfter.title: Cobras DESPUÉS de entregar.
paidAfter.body: A los fans nunca se les cobra hasta que envías tu trabajo terminado y el Consejo confirma que cumple con la recompensa.

chargesFinal.title: Los cargos son definitivos para los fans, pero aún puede haber reembolsos.
chargesFinal.body: Un fan no puede exigir que le devuelvan su dinero una vez cobrado. Pero un contracargo, un reembolso que Artypot emite para solucionar un problema o un reembolso que tú decides emitir se descuenta de tu saldo, que puede quedar en negativo y se compensa con las ganancias futuras. Los contracargos y los reembolsos emitidos por Artypot te devuelven la comisión de plataforma; los reembolsos que inicias tú mismo no.

refundBounty.title: Puedes reembolsar una recompensa entera.
refundBounty.body: Si necesitas arreglar las cosas, puedes reembolsar a todos los patrocinadores de una recompensa desde tu panel, siempre que tu saldo lo cubra. Si no, el soporte puede ayudarte.

publicWork.title: Las recompensas financian trabajo público, no ventajas privadas.
publicWork.body: Tu entregable llega a todo el mundo por igual. No puedes intercambiar patrocinios por acceso privado, bienes físicos, quedadas o recompensas: un agradecimiento público es la única ventaja permitida.

noOfficialActs.title: Nada de pagos por actos oficiales o campañas.
noOfficialActs.body: No puedes aceptar una recompensa por nada que hagas en un cargo público, ni usar Artypot para financiar una campaña, un candidato o un esfuerzo electoral.

realPeople.title: Solo personas reales, no marcas (todavía).
realPeople.body: Las cuentas de creador son para personas que se registran por sí mismas. Si gestionas las redes sociales de una empresa u organización, todavía no puedes registrar esa marca como creadora: el soporte para entidades comerciales llegará más adelante.

goodFaith.title: Actúa de buena fe.
goodFaith.body: Los comentarios engañosos, las entregas tramposas, la suplantación de identidad y otras conductas de mala fe no se toleran.

belowTheLaw.title: Artypot está por debajo de la ley.
belowTheLaw.body: Tenemos que recopilar información fiscal. Por ahora, los pagos a creadores son solo para EE. UU. (se requiere una cuenta bancaria de EE. UU.) y estamos trabajando para sumar más países. A algunos no podemos prestarles servicio en absoluto, por ley.

fundsClear.title: Los fondos se liberan tras 7 días.
fundsClear.body: Los fondos recaudados se retienen 7 días (para revisión de fraude y disputas) antes de poder retirarse, sujeto a un saldo mínimo de pago.

copyright.title: Conservas tus derechos de autor.
copyright.body: Nada de esto transfiere la propiedad de tu trabajo a Artypot ni a ningún fan. Solo concedes una licencia limitada para mostrar y promocionar tus trabajos terminados en la plataforma.

familyFriendly.title: Artypot es apto para toda la familia.
familyFriendly.body: El texto de tu recompensa, tu perfil, tus nombres de usuario y tus notas de finalización son públicos y deben ser aptos para todos los públicos. Tampoco puedes usar una recompensa para financiar contenido para adultos (nuestros socios de pago lo prohíben). Nada ilegal. Lo que crees y alojes en otro sitio es asunto tuyo.
